main_body: Fish tank: a wide glass tank with an orange-brown wooden frame, water, sand bed and plants, drawn as a flat front view
top_band: none. Rows 9-12 show a thin brown rim (1-2px) with a dark strip above it; nothing reads as a horizontal surface seen from above. A light-blue band at rows 13-14 is the glass/water front, not a top.
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: dark top strip at rows 8-9, a brown rim at rows 9-12 (about 2px), then the front glass with water, sand and plants down to row 30. The water surface is a flat horizontal line, not an ellipse, and no opening or lid is visible from above. The tank is a front elevation with only a thin rim, so it fails the 3/4 contract. It is also a low wide aquarium rather than tall wall furniture, so the kind does not fit well.

style.evidence: The frame outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is good. The water is made of two or three blues and the large blue areas are mostly flat, with only a few highlight dots and plant pixels. The sand has some two-tone grain. The wood frame has only about 2-3 steps. Compared with the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and per-element texture, this piece is flatter and has fewer colours per tile, so it is a little thinner.
